title: DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, October 3, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, October 3, 2018 Posted by admin on October 3rd, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include APple (AAPL), Boeing (BA), Cisco (CSCO), Merck (MRK), Microsoft (MSFT) and UnitedHealth (UNH). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +97 points.
Tuesday the Dow was up +122.73 (+0.46%) at 26,773.94.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +8.31%.
There were 24 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Intel (INTC) +3.55% and 3M (MMM) +1.66%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Nike (NKE) -2.00% and Home Depot (HD) -1.37%.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is up 1.7 cents at $2.902 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
Nike (NKE) reported earnings on 9/25/2018 after the market close of $0.67, just beating estimates calling for $0.657 per share.
Walgreens (WBA) reports earnings on 10/11/18 before the market open.
Today’s Featured Dow Stock
Merck (MRK)
Merck (MRK) is up +27.51% year-to-date.
